search.description:
The `search` function performs a product search based on the parameters. It updates the search context and emits events consumed by containers such as `SearchResults`, `Facets`, `Pagination`, and `SortBy`.

Passing `null` as the `variables` parameter clears the current search state and resets related containers.
parameters: Search phrase. Use an empty string for category-only searches.
Number of products to return per page.
Array of filter objects. Each filter must specify an attribute and condition (`contains`, `eq`, `in`, `range`, or `startsWith`).
Array of sort objects containing an attribute and direction (`ASC` or `DESC`).
search.returns: Returns a promise that resolves when the search completes and related events have been emitted.   No direct return payload; containers update automatically based on the emitted events.
